mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_task (message_id, user_id, content, status, retry_count, last_error) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, user_id, content, status, retry_count, last_error, create_time, update_time FROM push_task WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM push_task WHERE status = #{status}
